proof.case: StreamingResponse body yields one neutral pending SSE comment and then raises RuntimeError(transaction failed)

control_case.case: StreamingResponse body raises before first body yield

interpretation: The keepalive itself is not the sole cause: returning StreamingResponse commits HTTP 200 before the async body result is known. Therefore a Stage-B design that starts StreamingResponse while the durable transaction is still pending must explicitly define/project a terminal SSE failure event (or equivalent protocol-visible failure) rather than relying on task.result() raising after response start. The existing pre-Stage-B server waits for provider completion before constructing StreamingResponse, so provider failures can still return JSON 502/503 before response start.
required_before_same_byte_promotion: Specify exact streaming failure projection semantics for durable transaction failure after response start.
Add an ASGI-level regression asserting no response/tool/provider IDs before durable finalize and a deterministic protocol-visible failure after a pending keepalive when the transaction fails.
Keep server-owned task cancellation isolation unchanged; do not cancel or retry provider work because the client projection disconnects.
